div.p: The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.6.0. This release marks a major update to the PHP language.
PHP 8.6 comes with numerous improvements and new features such as:

ul.li: New Io\Poll API for monitoring streams

div.p: See what’s new in PHP 8.6 for more highlights and examples.
Source downloads for PHP 8.6.0 are available on our downloads page. Windows source and binaries are available on the Windows downloads page. The list of changes is recorded in the ChangeLog.
The migration guide in the PHP Manual lists new features and backward-incompatible changes in detail.
Kudos to all the contributors and supporters!
